title: Person
description: A human being who holds or held a public role. A Person record carries identity only - never the office, the term, or the body. Those live on the Role, so that one person can hold several offices over time without duplicate Person records.

name.description: Full name as the person presents it.

alternateName.description: Transliterations and other-script forms. Do not assume given/family decomposition applies to every naming culture; name is the authoritative field and the decomposed parts are optional.

email.description: Official contact only. Do not publish personal contact details.
